input: Consider: Our code review process requires two approvals before merge
output_summary: Applied invariants lens: Identified hard invariant: test coverage cannot decrease below threshold. Soft constraint: two-approval rule (negotiable, could be one or three). If hard invariant violated: regression risk increases. Who benefits: the two-approval rule benefits maintainers who want to feel consulted.
test_notes: Lens successfully distinguished hard invariants from soft constraints. The distinction between must-hold and nice-to-have revealed that the review rule was treated as hard when it was actually negotiable.
